title: AidPage Dex — rule-based, rank-free multi-lens profiles of Korean municipalities (v1.4) with national aid thresholds and recorded outcomes
description: Rule-based typology of 255 Korean municipal units (si/gun/gu): natural hazards (flood history, landslide/slope, coastal contact, drought zones), a social hazard (traffic), unordered vulnerability traits, and ordinance holdings. National top-quartile thresholds within the same unit class; no composite score or ranking. v1.4 adds the national recovery-aid threshold layer (fiscal-capacity bands, Regulation art. 5①, in force 2024-11-19) and recorded outcomes from the Disaster Yearbook 2012–2024. Sensitivity specifications (p70/p80, 229 units) shipped for review. Files: data/ref/sgg_types.json, sgg_threshold.json, sgg_type_specs.json, sgg_ordin.json; viewer: dex.html.
